verdict.rationale: Docusign documents a public eSignature REST API on its Developer Center and publishes official OpenAPI/Swagger specifications and an official Node.js client library. Hands-on community reports confirm developers built production integrations against it and describe the documentation as thorough. One report of an embedded-flow problem is a criticism of a specific integration, not evidence that the API is missing. Missing for 10: OpenAPI spec and llms.txt are not discoverable at standard developer-site paths (probes returned 404), and the pack has no detailed endpoint-level documentation excerpts.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
